get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations between different object types, with a limit of 500 results per call. It is useful for understanding the relationships between various CRM objects.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the associated objects to be listed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token that serves as a cursor for fetching the next page of results.

link.description: A URL string that provides a direct link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with multiple labels. Each object includes details about the associated object and its labels.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications, each including a label. These define the types of associations between the objects.

category.description: The category of the association, which can be 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', or 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the object type ID from which the association originates.

label.description: A string that provides an optional label for the association.

toObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the object type ID to which the association points.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the association type.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the target object to which associations are made. This is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
